This '''landing meadow''' was located just outside the forest on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] sent a team of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to retrieve [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] from Dathomir, as well as a group of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], whom they intended to convert into Sith. They arrived in the landing meadow, where they [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|captured]] the Nightsisters. The team then took the Nightsisters to the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|main fleet]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], while the team's leader, [[Viun Gaalan]], stayed behind with three [[Sith Saber]]s to await Khai, who was retrieving [[Halliava Vurse|one last Nightsister]]. However, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], and the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]] arrived and attacked the Sith, defeating them in a [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|duel]] and forcing Gaalan to flee as Khai arrived on the scene. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] then took Khai captive.
